findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "bridge_prepare_payment" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bridge_prepare_payment, x402_check · Private data: bridge_quote, stocks_vault, stocks_portfolio, stocks_create_vault, stocks_set_weights, stocks_buy, stocks_sell, stocks_rebalance, stocks_send, polymarket_prepare, polymarket_price_to_beat, stocks_publish_prepare, x402_check, payment_readiness, gas_sponsor_info · Public sink: stocks_create_vault, stocks_set_weights, stocks_buy, stocks_sell, stocks_rebalance, stocks_send, stocks_publish_prepare, gas_sponsor_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bridge_prepare_payment, x402_check · Private data: bridge_quote, stocks_vault, stocks_portfolio, stocks_create_vault, stocks_set_weights, stocks_buy, stocks_sell, stocks_rebalance, stocks_send, polymarket_prepare, polymarket_price_to_beat, stocks_publish_prepare, x402_check, payment_readiness, gas_sponsor_info · Public sink: stocks_create_vault, stocks_set_weights, stocks_buy, stocks_sell, stocks_rebalance, stocks_send, stocks_publish_prepare, gas_sponsor_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
